method: Menu latency starts at actual in-page pointerdown and reports browser frame opportunities, not hardware pixels. Cold n=3 separate processes/contexts with OS cache retained; warm n=30 per entry/mode. Heavy flows use maximum EventTiming duration per interactionId per page, durationThreshold=16: faster unreported interactions are absent, never counted as zero. Driver/assertion elapsed is not used. Each round retains raw traces, long tasks and videos; no claim of native 60fps.
